text: 全球流量前20大网站，听说不需要科学上网可以直接浏览的只有两个。
en: Among the world's top 20 websites by traffic, I hear only two can be browsed directly without bypassing the firewall.

text: 一个是百度，另外一个是亚马逊。
en: One is Baidu, and the other is Amazon.

text: 前者不用多说，各种广告骗子一大堆。
en: The former needs no introduction: all kinds of advertising scammers in droves.

text: 后者是购物网站，你会海淘吗？
en: The latter is a shopping website — do you do overseas shopping?

text: 呵呵🙂
en: Heh. 🙂

text: 翻墙出去看8个小时外网，再刷几个小时科研论坛。
en: Bypass the firewall to browse the outside internet for 8 hours, then scroll research forums for a few more hours.

text: 然后工资不会涨，阶层不会提升，跟朋友吃饭吹牛也用不到，还是该吃吃该喝喝，
en: Then your salary will not rise, your class will not improve, and you cannot use it when bragging with friends over dinner either — you still eat and drink as usual.

text: 要那么多信息干嘛呢，够用就行了呗。
en: Why do you need so much information? Enough is enough.

text: 其实很简单，搜与你观点相反的内容即可。
en: Actually, it is very simple: just search for content opposite to your views.

text: 比如，我信佛十几年了，然后去搜唯物主义，他们对世界的看法，那是另外一种视角。
en: For example, I have believed in Buddhism for more than ten years, and then I searched for materialism — their view of the world is a different perspective.

text: 比如，我会去看台湾的政论节目，他们的视角，观点跟大陆是个不同的。
en: For example, I watch Taiwan's political commentary programmes; their perspectives and views are different from the mainland's.

text: 所有的报道都有倾向性，为了避免被误导，首先要保持最基本的逻辑，参考客观指标，再结合历史，因为太阳底下没有新鲜事。
en: All reporting has tendencies. To avoid being misled, first maintain basic logic, refer to objective indicators, and combine with history, because there is nothing new under the sun.

text: 先看基本逻辑和客观指标，比如牢A的言论就是典型的以点概面。
en: First look at basic logic and objective indicators. For example, Prisoner A's remarks are a typical case of generalising from a single point.

text: 美国那么坏，遍地饿殍，为什么有钱人都纷纷往美国跑。
en: America is so bad, with starving people everywhere — why do rich people all flock to America?

text: 中国那么好，购买力平价（PPP）计算的GDP排名第一，为什么没见过欧美日韩的人偷渡到中国扫地、刷盘子？
en: China is so good, with GDP ranked first calculated by purchasing power parity (PPP) — why have we never seen Europeans, Americans, Japanese or Koreans sneak into China to sweep floors or wash dishes?

text: 再看历史：
en: Then look at history:

text: 当年教员对于基辛格提出的，当时全国各地都刷满“打倒美帝国主义”反美口号的回应是；
en: Back then, the Teacher's response to what Kissinger raised, when 'Down with American imperialism' anti-American slogans were plastered all over the country, was:

text: “像我这样的人，也放过不少空炮，什么‘全世界人民团结起来打倒帝国主义、修正主义和一切反动派’，口号嘛。
en: “People like me have also fired quite a few empty cannons — things like 'People of the world, unite to overthrow imperialism, revisionism and all reactionaries' — slogans, that's all.

text: 他笑了笑，又指了指尼克松：“你们不也常常说要消灭共产主义？
en: He smiled and pointed at Nixon: “Don't you also often say you want to eliminate communism?

text: 几十年了，也没消灭掉。
en: Decades have passed, and it hasn't been eliminated.

text: 我只说自己的一些技巧吧。
en: I will just talk about some of my own techniques.

text: 作为一个每天用三个小时以后在知乎回答，内容比较杂学的答主，我的信息获取是这样的——
en: As an answerer who spends more than three hours a day on Zhihu answering, with rather mixed content, my information acquisition goes like this —

text: 首先，对热点新闻只看长期关注的权威博主内容。
en: First, for hot news, I only read content from authoritative bloggers I have followed for a long time.

text: 大量自媒体号，其实都是迎合情绪，把一些核心信息翻来覆去的扩展解读。
en: A large number of self-media accounts actually just cater to emotions, expanding and interpreting some core information over and over.

text: 有效信息很少。
en: There is very little effective information.

text: 所以，热点新闻或者看大型媒体的第一手客观报道，或者看权威博主的解读。
en: So, for hot news, either read first-hand objective reporting from large media, or read interpretations from authoritative bloggers.

text: 不要看那些切片或二手三手的引用再解读。
en: Do not read those sliced-up or second-hand, third-hand quoted reinterpretations.

text: 第二，用电脑替代手机浏览
en: Second, use a computer instead of a phone to browse.

text: 电脑有个好处，可以不授权cookie，甚至不登录的情况下查看网页。
en: A computer has one advantage: you can view web pages without authorising cookies, or even without logging in.

text: 这就避免了用手机观看新闻、视频时候的“用户爱好推荐”。
en: This avoids the 'user preference recommendations' you get when watching news and videos on a phone.

text: 能避免搜索了一个关键词，最近连续都给你推荐类似的东西。
en: It avoids the situation where, after searching for a keyword, you are continuously recommended similar things.

text: 你也可以在手机端关闭“兴趣推荐、用户改进计划”等设置，单个人觉得效果有限。
en: You can also turn off settings like 'interest recommendations' and 'user improvement plans' on your phone, though I personally find the effect limited.

text: 尤其是“百度”的搜索记录，会授权给好几个购物和娱乐平台。
en: Especially Baidu's search history, which is authorised to several shopping and entertainment platforms.

text: 所以，只要你搜过某样东西，立刻回看到京东、淘宝都给你推荐相关物品，页面广告也围绕。
en: So, as soon as you search for something, you will immediately see JD and Taobao recommending related items to you, and page ads revolving around it.

text: 所以，我一般是不登陆百度账号的，使用了网盘功能也会立刻退出。
en: So I generally do not log into a Baidu account, and I log out immediately after using the cloud drive function.

text: 第三，多交叉利用平台来获取信息
en: Third, cross-utilise platforms to obtain information.

text: 我个人日常会至少登录五个以上的平台来获取信息。
en: I personally log into at least five or more platforms daily to obtain information.

text: 比如早晨上班，会用公众号听播，在路上听一些中长内容的新闻、时事账号。
en: For example, in the morning on the way to work, I use official accounts to listen to broadcasts, listening to some medium-to-long news and current affairs accounts on the road.

text: 到了公司会打开anyknew 这样新闻合集网站看当日的各大网站头条。
en: When I get to the company, I open a news aggregation site like AnyKnew to see the day's headlines from major websites.

text: 它的页面是这样瀑布流形式展现所有门户、新闻网站头条新闻的，你可以横向对比热搜。
en: Its page displays headlines from all portals and news websites in a waterfall format, allowing you to horizontally compare trending searches.

text: 搜图片我会用360搜索和一些国外的图片搜索引擎，因为更客观而且图源更丰富。
en: For searching images, I use 360 Search and some foreign image search engines, because they are more objective and have richer image sources.

text: 没有太多商品推荐。
en: Without too many product recommendations.

text: 健身房，一般是听苹果自带的播客和小宇宙、喜马拉雅来听中长的播客内容来学习历史、财经、国际关系方面的内容。
en: At the gym, I generally listen to Apple's built-in podcasts and Xiaoyuzhou and Ximalaya to listen to medium-to-long podcast content to learn about history, finance and international relations.

text: 下班后，在家我一般偏娱乐向内容是看B站。
en: After work, at home, I generally prefer entertainment-oriented content on Bilibili.

text: 如果看书，会用Kindle下载，或者是腾讯读书。
en: If I read books, I download them with Kindle, or use Tencent Reading.

text: 我很少刷微博、抖音、快手，因为里面的内容太碎片，有效信息很少，经常看了一两个小时发现除了杀时间没有得到任何有效内容。
en: I rarely scroll Weibo, Douyin or Kuaishou, because their content is too fragmented, with very little effective information. I often find that after watching for an hour or two, apart from killing time, I have gained no effective content.

text: 重要，多用排行榜而不是推荐来看内容。
en: Important: use rankings rather than recommendations to view content.

text: 其中比较重要的，是不管你用上面的哪个平台，可以多利用“分类排行榜”，来看每天排名前几的内容。
en: What is more important is that, no matter which of the above platforms you use, you can make more use of 'category rankings' to see the top-ranked content each day.

text: 它们相对更客观反应整个平台用户的判断，而且往往能有一些你从来不关注的领域信息。
en: They relatively more objectively reflect the judgment of the platform's users as a whole, and often bring you information from fields you never follow.

text: 我们用B站举例。
en: Take Bilibili as an example.

text: 我无聊时打法时间的方法，不是看系统推荐给我的哪些视频。
en: My way of passing time when bored is not to watch the videos the system recommends to me.

text: 而是点击左上角“热门”去看每天的综合热门，每周的推荐，每个专区的排行榜。
en: But to click 'Hot' in the top-left corner to see the daily comprehensive hot list, the weekly recommendations, and the rankings of each section.

text: 比如你是个从不关心音乐领域的人，一样可以在榜单中发现原来AI作曲已经这么流行了，创作出了不少播放上千万的经典歌曲。
en: For example, if you are someone who never cares about the music field, you can still discover from the rankings that AI composition has become so popular, creating quite a few classic songs with tens of millions of plays.

text: 或者你是个从来不爱看记录片的人，但发现热榜上又一部忽然几万人点赞的纪录片。
en: Or if you are someone who never likes watching documentaries, but find that another documentary on the hot list suddenly has tens of thousands of likes.

text: 点进去可能发现一部大家都在套论的热门视频。
en: Clicking in, you might discover a popular video everyone is discussing.

text: 这样“看榜单”的习惯，要比“只看系统推荐给你”的内容，更加视野开拓。
en: This habit of 'looking at rankings' broadens your horizons more than 'only looking at content the system recommends to you'.

text: 最后，和朋友们保持交流。
en: Finally, stay in touch with friends.

text: 很多人会发现，一旦从学校毕业，没有了“同学、舍友”这样的氛围，自己了解新事物的范围会异常狭小。
en: Many people find that once they graduate from school, without the atmosphere of 'classmates and roommates', the range of new things they learn becomes unusually narrow.

text: 再没有了那种“发生了什么事立刻从别人那听说”的感觉。
en: There is no longer that feeling of 'immediately hearing from others when something happens'.

text: 这就需要我们要建立新的“社交信息渠道”。
en: This requires us to establish new 'social information channels'.

text: 比如：每天上班时，有一两个关系不错的同事，大家找空下楼抽根烟、喝杯咖啡，闲聊20分钟，交流下最近自己再看的剧、听说的新闻。
en: For example: every day at work, having one or two colleagues you get along well with, finding time to go downstairs for a cigarette or a coffee, chatting for 20 minutes, exchanging what shows you are watching recently and what news you have heard.

text: 比如我太太喜欢的书籍和博主与我完全不同，但我俩每周会去公园散步两个小时，路上聊聊这周各自看了什么书，听到了哪些博主的有趣内容。
en: For example, my wife's favourite books and bloggers are completely different from mine, but every week we take a two-hour walk in the park, chatting on the way about what books we each read this week and what interesting blogger content we heard.

text: 遇到都喜欢的还会晚上一起看。
en: When we both like something, we watch it together in the evening.

text: 这些都是“保持你和他人的交流”。
en: These are all 'staying in touch with others'.

text: 虽然很多现代人都说自己有“社交恐惧症”，但交流不一定非是当面的，加入一些讨论群，或者在手机上保持和几个好友的小群，都是交流信息不错的方式。
en: Although many modern people say they have 'social phobia', communication does not have to be face-to-face. Joining some discussion groups, or keeping small groups with a few good friends on your phone, are also good ways to exchange information.

text: 你也可以定期周末约朋友玩桌游、拼图、打篮球，大家的交流一样会带给你很多不知道的信息。
en: You can also regularly meet friends on weekends to play board games, do puzzles, or play basketball; everyone's exchanges will likewise bring you a lot of information you did not know.
